post.description: Explicit approval of one immutable storyboard, guarded by current draft revision/hash and full candidate contentHash. approve must be true. Candidate must be at the saved draft revision or exactly match its fresh applied working copy. Same-key replay returns the historical approval after later edits; changed input returns 409. New keys recheck freshness and deduplicate approval for the same candidate. No inherited approval, provider call, selection change, video creation or rendering authorization. Migration 010 required.

post.description: Freeze the exact saved valid non-stale working plan into an immutable manual candidate, without provider calls, approval, draft mutation or selection changes. Requires expected draft revision and draft contentHash. Same-key replay returns the original storyboardId even after later edits. Concurrent saves conflict. Migration 009 required.

post.description: Queues an immutable storyboard-source revision. Requires current draft revision, exact source hash and either a source at that revision or its unchanged fresh applied working copy. Manual edited plans first become immutable sources through storyboard-snapshots. Video sources are unsupported. Same-key replay recovers the shared storyboard receipt; provider work never happens inside the HTTP request. Results preserve the source, draft and selection, and expose parentId/changedSceneIds/changeSummary in existing storyboard reads. Every result needs review; no approval is inherited.

post.description: Enqueues a persisted MongoDB job and returns 202 before provider work. A separate worker makes up to four 30-second calls total, including targeted validation repairs and bounded transient HTTP retries. Receipt deadline is 180 seconds from enqueue; unclaimed queue expiry becomes failed/QUEUE_EXPIRED, while claimed expiry becomes unknown and fences late results. Optional stage, attempt and sanitized issueCodes support polling. Same-key replay never enqueues again. Running work is never reclaimed after a worker crash. No Inngest job, automatic apply or approval.

post.description: Signed Meta deletion callback. Requires lifecycle and deletion flags plus migrations 020/021. Same subject and issued_at replay returns the same opaque confirmation code. Verified mapped data is removed transactionally; unknown publication outcomes, newer consent or ambiguous identity/history remain under operator review. Generated videos, login accounts, Instagram posts and minimal replay/duplicate safety records are retained. No auth cookies required.

200.description: Durable receipt; this response does not mean deletion completed. Open the status URL.

503.description: Disabled, configuration/migration missing, or transaction failed. Retry delivery.

post.description: Meta server callback. Disabled unless INSTAGRAM_LIFECYCLE_ENABLED=1 and migration 020 is ready. Requires HMAC-SHA256 signed_request from the configured Instagram app. App-scoped subject mapping is captured during OAuth. No session/cookie/origin required. Revokes saved credentials; pauses unsent work, leaves submitted outcomes for manual review. Does not delete local projects or Instagram posts.

200.description: Callback applied or replay acknowledged; no account details.

post.description: Disabled unless INSTAGRAM_REFRESH_ENABLED=1. Requires a distinct server-only bearer, empty body and no query. Renews at most one eligible admitted direct account; never publishes or renders.

200.description: Bounded maintenance result; no tokens/account IDs.

post.description: Creates a ten-minute, single-use session-bound authorization. New connects supersede earlier callbacks. Only a configured HTTPS same-origin callback is accepted. Uses direct Instagram Login only: no Facebook Page or Page ID is accepted. Instagram provider and app are pinned to the receipt. Legacy Facebook configuration cannot start new authorizations.

200.description: Owner-scoped response. Authorization alone does not submit media; publishing has a separate rollout gate.
